crossRefs.note: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of…
“Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

translations.web: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
translations.bsb: Nor should you swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
translations.kjv: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
translations.asv: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, for thou canst not make one hair white or black.
